snippet.title: Teardown Rally - Free Multiplayer Update Coming Soon
snippet.description:
Buckle up! Teardown Rally is on the way - and it’s FREE!

Our brand-new game mode is still in the works, and we can’t wait to get you behind the wheel! Compete in quick races, tournaments and cups with a fresh lineup of speedy Rally Cars and mighty Monster Trucks, each with its own distinct handling. Find your favourite, floor it and try to remember where the brakes are.

Picture 12 players drifting across Frozen Lake, launching off massive jumps in the Quarry and making a spectacular mess of the landing. That’s the kind of racing we’re here for.

And who says you have to stay in the car? Hop out, wreck your opponents’ vehicles and help your team take the win. Overtaking is much easier when the other car isn’t going anywhere.

Stay Connected
Join the Teardown Discord:  https://discord.com/invite/teardown
X: https://x.com/teardowngame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/teardowngame
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/PlayTeardownGame
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/TeardownGame
Website: https://www.teardowngame.com
